name: v131_ebit_delivery_cap45_market
hypothesis: A stricter large-cap gate may push the EBIT actual-delivery seed across the TOP1000 sub-universe check with minimal change to the parent.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_ebit_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_mean / assets, 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_ebit_value - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_mean) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_ebit_std / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.130 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.110 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)
